risks.description: The drawing title explicitly calls the component cold formed, but the shop profile does not list a dedicated cold-heading/cold-extrusion machine. The plan therefore uses an outside cold-forming vendor or existing outsourcing source before in-house finish operations.
risks.mitigation: Confirm existing supplier/tooling for drawing 359110 or similar 348671; use Almity tool-room support for gauges/fixtures and secondary workholding.

risks.description: Several stepped internal bore/cavity depths and transitions are not fully resolved from the raster drawing, which limits cycle-time formula completeness for secondary boring and forming operations.
risks.mitigation: Obtain native drawing/CAD or supplier process drawing before final cycle-time release; current route treats the internal profile as coaxial cold-formed near-net geometry.

risks.description: The derived wall near the Ø7.18 cavity and Ø9.12 OD is about 0.97 mm, so excessive collet pressure during finish turning could distort datum A or the bore.
risks.mitigation: Use precision split collet/soft bushing with low, repeatable clamping force; inspect OD and runout in-process.

risks.description: The leakage requirement states 10 SCCM max but does not define pressure, medium, dwell, or fixture details in the feature graph.
risks.mitigation: Confirm leakage test parameters and build a dedicated test fixture before production release.

outside_processes_needed.reason: The part title says cold formed and the geometry is a small C10C axisymmetric hollow plunger with formed internal seat/lip features; the provided Almity profile does not list a dedicated cold-heading machine family.
outside_processes_needed.sequence_position: first operation, before in-house CNC lathe finishing

feasibility.assessment_notes: Feasible using an outsourced cold-formed near-net blank followed by in-house CNC lathe finishing, deburr/cleaning, dimensional inspection, and leakage testing. No heat treatment or coating is specified.

starting_dimensions.notes: Use a near-net cold-formed/cold-headed blank. Finished envelope dimensions Ø9.12 × 9.65 mm are shown here as the near-net bounding size because exact wire diameter, slug length, and die allowances are not provided in the feature graph.

stock.why: The title block identifies the part as 'PLUNGER, LEAKDOWN (COLD FORMED)'. C10C is suitable for cold forming, the part is very small and axisymmetric, and the internal seat/lip features are formed-type geometry. At 1000 pieces, use existing/supplier cold-form tooling if available; otherwise this is still the drawing-specified manufacturing basis. CNC lathe finishing is retained for datum OD/end faces and external edge details.

evidence.cited_text: Finished envelope cylindrical, length 9.65 mm, max diameter 9.12 mm, estimated mass 2.3 grams.
Cold formed near-net blank selected because the drawing title specifies cold formed and the shop has no listed cold-heading machine.

route.route_name: Outsourced cold-formed blank + in-house CNC lathe finish, deburr, inspect, leak test
route.route_reason: The part is a small cylindrical C10C leakdown plunger with all major features coaxial about datum A. The title explicitly specifies cold formed, so the route starts with cold-heading/cold-extrusion of the hollow stepped internal form. Turning is then used for the precision Ø9.12 datum OD, datum end faces, chamfer/radius, and any accessible right-cavity cleanup. No milling, heat treatment, grinding, or coating is required by the feature graph.

setups.machine_reason: The drawing title requires a cold-formed plunger and the internal seat/cavity details are best made by cold heading/extrusion. Almity's provided machine inventory does not include a cold-heading machine, so this forming step is routed to an outside vendor.

workholding.grip_description: C10C wire or slug is contained and transferred through progressive dies along the part axis.
workholding.fixture_notes: Dedicated punches/dies are required for the Ø7.18 cavity, Ø4/Ø2.4 passage, spherical seat, Detail-B mouth/lip, and local radii.

datum_references: forming die axis used as precursor to datum A
setups.stock_state_before: C10C cold-heading wire/slug; exact wire diameter and blank length to be confirmed by die design.
setups.stock_state_after: Near-net cold-formed hollow plunger blank with coaxial stepped internal profile, formed lip/seat geometry, and external cylindrical envelope ready for finish turning/deburr.

sub_operations.operation_name: Prepare C10C cold-heading slug/wire volume for 2.3 g plunger
sub_operations.reason: Cold heading requires correct blank volume before forming; blank volume must match the finished near-net part volume with minimal waste.

tool.tool_description: Wire feed, shear knife, transfer fingers, and volume-control tooling
tool.notes: Exact slug dimensions require supplier die design.

sub_operations.notes: Actual wire diameter and slug length are not specified; use supplier cold-heading layout.

sub_operations.operation_name: Cold form main cylindrical shell, datum-A precursor OD, and large right cavity Ø7.18
sub_operations.reason: Forms the main hollow body and large coaxial right-end cavity before any finish turning; this follows the drawing's cold-formed manufacturing intent and minimizes machining waste.

tool.tool_description: Forming punch/die set for hollow shell and large right-side cavity
tool.notes: Include generous radiused punch transitions for F014.

sub_operations.notes: Exact cavity depth is unresolved; supplier die design must map the section depths.

sub_operations.operation_name: Cold form coaxial inner bore Ø4

tool.tool_description: Cold-forming punch for Ø4 coaxial internal passage

sub_operations.notes: General tolerance applies; no reaming/honing specified.

sub_operations.operation_name: Cold form reduced coaxial orifice Ø2.4
sub_operations.reason: The reduced orifice is coaxial and datum-A referenced; forming it in the same die stack preserves axis relationship before finish turning datum A.

tool.notes: Protect against punch deflection; maintain coaxiality to die axis.

sub_operations.notes: Exact axial length/depth of the orifice remains to be confirmed.

sub_operations.operation_name: Cold form left chamber Ø4.763 and spherical seat SØ3.175
sub_operations.reason: The check-valve seat/chamber is a formed sealing geometry; creating it during cold forming gives good surface continuity and grain flow with minimal machining.

tool.notes: Seat surface must be protected from galling and contamination.

sub_operations.notes: Leakage performance depends heavily on this formed seat quality.

sub_operations.operation_name: Cold form Detail-B mouth Ø6.88, Ø7.0 lip, 15° taper, and local radii
sub_operations.reason: Detail-B contains formed lip/mouth geometry, significant Ø6.88 characteristic, taper, and radii; these should be produced in the forming die before secondary deburring and inspection.

formula_inputs.die_type: Detail-B lip and taper forming die

tool.tool_description: Detail-B profile die/punch for mouth diameter, taper, and local radii
tool.notes: No raised metal permitted at the indicated lip/edge.

sub_operations.notes: Feature F013 has multiple local radii; schema has no separate radius-list field, so radii are tracked by feature ID and tool notes.

setups.outside_reason: Dedicated cold-heading/cold-extrusion equipment is not listed in the Almity shop profile.
setups.inspection_at_setup: Vendor to provide first-piece report for formed OD precursor, internal diameters, significant Ø6.88, and visual check for folds/cracks.
setups.setup_reason: Create the geometry that is specified as cold formed before any secondary finishing.
assumptions: Cold-form supplier can produce the coaxial internal profile from C10C.
Exact slug diameter, blank length, number of blows, and die station layout will be defined by vendor/tooling.

setups.machine_reason: The work is rotational and coaxial. CNC lathe is the lowest-cost accurate machine for facing, OD finishing, and external chamfering on the Ø9.12 cylindrical datum surface.

workholding.fixture_notes: Use a part-specific split collet or soft bushing to avoid distorting the thin wall around the large internal cavity.

setups.stock_state_before: Near-net cold-formed hollow blank from S001 with formed internal profile.
setups.stock_state_after: Left datum face C established, datum-A OD finish turned to Ø9.12 nominal, and left external chamfer produced.

sub_operations.operation_name: Face left end to establish datum C
sub_operations.reason: Datum C is referenced by the OD perpendicularity control; establish a clean axial face before final OD finishing.

tool.tool_description: Sharp positive-rake carbide facing tool for low-carbon steel
tool.notes: Use light facing cut only; exact stock allowance is not defined.

sub_operations.notes: Facing stock allowance is unknown, so cut_length_mm is left null pending supplier blank allowance.

sub_operations.operation_name: Finish turn datum-A OD to Ø9.12 ±0.025 over 9.65 length
sub_operations.reason: Datum A drives runout of the internal features and right face; finish OD after datum C face is established.

tool.tool_description: Fine-nose carbide finishing insert for Ø9.12 datum OD
tool.notes: Use light pass and stable collet support; no heat-treat stock allowance required.

sub_operations.notes: Starting diameter is assumed near-net from cold forming; final size is controlled by this pass or calibration/spring pass.

sub_operations.reason: External edge break/chamfer is specified at the left end and should be done in the same axial setup after the face and OD are established.

tool.notes: Drawing allows optional 22° alternative; default route uses primary 45° callout.

sub_operations.operation_name: In-process check datum C face and datum-A OD
sub_operations.reason: OD Ø9.12 ±0.025 defines datum A and must be verified before flipping for datum B/right-face work.

tool.tool_type: OD micrometer and face/runout check fixture
tool.tool_description: In-process gauge set for Ø9.12 OD and left face condition

sub_operations.notes: Check before unclamping to protect datum transfer into the second lathe setup.

setups.inspection_at_setup: Measure Ø9.12 OD, verify left face cleanup and left chamfer size.
setups.setup_reason: Establish primary turning datums and finish the most important external cylindrical datum before the flip operation.
assumptions: Cold-formed blank has enough OD/face stock for a light cleanup pass.
Collet pressure can be controlled to avoid distorting the thin wall.

setups.setup_name: CNC lathe Op 2: finish datum B/right end and accessible right cavity
setups.machine_reason: The right face, right edge radius, and right-end internal cavity are coaxial to datum A, so they are best completed on the CNC lathe while gripping on the finished OD.

workholding.method: precision collet on finished datum-A OD with axial stop on datum C
workholding.grip_description: Grip the finished OD in a split collet or soft bushing; locate from datum C so the right face can be finished to overall length.
workholding.fixture_notes: A short, low-pressure collet setup is needed for the 9.65 mm long part and thin wall.

setups.stock_state_before: Part with datum C faced, datum-A OD finished, and left chamfer complete.
setups.stock_state_after: Right datum face B finished to overall length, right edge radius produced, and accessible right-end cavity verified/cleaned up as needed.

sub_operations.operation_name: Face right end to final overall length 9.65 ±0.13 and establish datum B
sub_operations.reason: Overall length is controlled between the end faces; datum B/right face also has a runout control to datum A.

tool.notes: Face against axial stop datum transfer; verify no burr at cavity mouth.

sub_operations.notes: Actual stock removal allowance on the right face is not specified.

sub_operations.operation_name: Finish/skim accessible right-end cavity Ø7.18 and internal R0.25 shoulder if required
sub_operations.reason: The Ø7.18 cavity has runout control to datum A and opens from datum B; after gripping on finished datum-A OD, a light boring/skim pass or gauging cleanup can improve coaxiality and remove forming lip burrs.

tool.tool_type: small carbide boring bar / form tool
tool.tool_description: Micro boring bar or formed cleanup tool for Ø7.18 right cavity and R0.25 transition
tool.notes: Use only if cold-formed cavity does not meet size/runout or has raised lip burr.

sub_operations.notes: hole_depth_mm is null because the drawing extraction did not resolve the cavity depth.

sub_operations.operation_name: Turn right external corner radius R0.25 nominal
sub_operations.reason: The right external edge radius modifies datum B/OD edge and is accessible in the same setup after facing.

tool.notes: Radius represented as chamfer_size_mm for formula geometry.

sub_operations.notes: Maintain the specified R0.25 ±0.13 external corner condition.

sub_operations.operation_name: In-process check overall length, right face runout, and right cavity mouth
sub_operations.reason: Verifies the flip setup before parts leave the lathe, especially datum B runout to datum A and overall length.

tool.tool_type: length gauge, dial indicator, bore gauge
tool.tool_description: In-process inspection equipment for length/runout/cavity size

sub_operations.notes: Use datum-A OD for runout check.

setups.inspection_at_setup: Check overall length 9.65 ±0.13, right face runout 0.04 to A, Ø7.18 cavity size/runout as applicable, and right R0.25 edge.
setups.setup_reason: Complete the opposite axial end while locating from the finished primary datum OD and datum C.
assumptions: Right-end cavity is accessible for light cleanup if the cold-formed cavity requires it.
No deep-hole boring cycle can be finalized until internal depths are confirmed.

setups.setup_name: Manual deburr, edge break, and clean/dry seat
setups.machine_reason: The drawing requires all sharp corners broken 0.25 max, no raised metal at Detail-B lip, and clean/dry check-valve seat. These are manual/bench finishing and cleaning tasks rather than CNC cutting tasks.

workholding.method: bench trays and small-part holding fixture
workholding.grip_description: Hold parts in soft small-part tray or pin fixture to avoid denting the thin lip/seat area.
workholding.fixture_notes: Use non-marring tools and magnification for Detail-B lip.

setups.stock_state_before: Finished/cold-formed plunger after lathe operations with possible light burrs and machining oil.
setups.stock_state_after: Edges broken, no raised metal at Detail-B lip, internal seat and passage cleaned and dried for inspection/test.

sub_operations.notes: Cleaning occurs after deburr and before final inspection/leak test.

setups.inspection_at_setup: Visual magnified check for no raised metal at Detail-B lip and clean/dry seat condition.
setups.setup_reason: Remove burrs before final inspection and leakage testing; hydraulic/check-valve parts cannot ship with loose or raised burrs.
assumptions: Manual deburr will not alter the significant Ø6.88 diameter or seat geometry.
Cleaning method is compatible with C10C and the leakage-test requirement.

setups.machine_reason: The shop profile includes in-house mechanical standard-room inspection. The part requires dimensional checks, significant characteristic verification, and runout checks to datum A.

workholding.fixture_notes: Dedicated check fixture recommended for datum-A runout, significant Ø6.88, and short-part length measurement.

setups.stock_state_before: Deburred, cleaned, dry part ready for final checks.
setups.stock_state_after: Dimensionally accepted part ready for leakage test.

sub_operations.operation_name: Inspect OD, overall length, end faces, chamfer, and radius
sub_operations.reason: Verifies the externally machined datum system before functional leakage testing.

sub_operations.operation_name: Inspect internal formed profile, significant Ø6.88, runouts to datum A, and no raised metal
sub_operations.reason: Internal profile and Detail-B lip/seat are function-critical for leakage and include a significant characteristic on Ø6.88.

tool.tool_description: Small bore gauges/pins for Ø2.4, Ø4, Ø4.763, Ø6.88/Ø7.18 checks plus visual magnification

Special small bore gauges/fixtures can be made or procured.

workholding.fixture_notes: Fixture pressure, medium, dwell time, and orientation must be confirmed from customer/test standard.

setups.stock_state_after: Leak-tested accepted plunger ready for packaging or customer release.

sub_operations.reason: Functional leakage is explicitly required by the drawing and is performed last after all machining, deburr, cleaning, and dimensional inspection.

tool.notes: Acceptance criterion is 10 SCCM max; missing test pressure/media must be confirmed.

sub_operations.notes: Perform after all cleaning; reject or segregate parts exceeding 10 SCCM.

setups.inspection_at_setup: Record leakage result against 10 SCCM max requirement.
setups.setup_reason: Functional requirement is final acceptance criterion and must not be done before burr/cleanliness issues are resolved.
assumptions: Leak test method can be implemented on Almity test bench once test pressure/media are confirmed.
No coating or heat treatment follows the leakage test.

routing_notes: Route sequences retrieved and overlaid: cold_heading for cold-formed blank, turning for coaxial OD/end-face finishing, and hole_making for bore/seat sequencing and deburr logic.
Heat treatment was not used because part-level spec states HEAT TREATMENT NONE.
Milling was not used because the part is fully axisymmetric/coaxial; VMC would not add value for the extracted features.
Cold-forming is first, soft finish turning is next, deburr/clean follows all cutting/forming, then dimensional inspection and leakage testing are last.
Internal bore depths are unresolved; affected formula_inputs use null for hole_depth_mm where required by the turning/hole-making formula family.
Use low clamping pressure and a split collet/soft bushing to avoid distortion of the thin wall near the Ø7.18 cavity.

clarifications.question: Confirm whether the SECTION A-A callout Ø7.18 ±0.1 is the large right-end internal bore/cavity diameter, rather than an external reduced diameter or another internal form diameter.
clarifications.why_it_matters: This affects feature classification, wall thickness, right-end boring/cleanup, and leakage-path geometry.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat Ø7.18 ±0.1 as a coaxial internal right-end cavity controlled to datum A.

clarifications.question: Confirm the exact axial depths/termination points of the Ø7.18 cavity, Ø4 bore, Ø2.4 orifice, and Ø4.763 left chamber in the stepped internal profile.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The route can be planned, but cycle-time formula inputs for bore/form depths cannot be completed without these depths.
clarifications.suggested_default: Use SECTION A-A as a stepped coaxial bore system and apply visible axial coordinates to the left seat/orifice region.

clarifications.question: Confirm datum feature attachments for boxed B and C: C as the left end face and B as the right end face.
clarifications.why_it_matters: Datum interpretation affects the face sequence and runout inspection method.
clarifications.suggested_default: Use C = left end face and B = right end face.

clarifications.question: Confirm that the feature-control symbols reading as runout-like controls 0.2 A, 0.25 A, and 0.04 A are circular runout controls rather than another ISO orientation/profile symbol.
clarifications.why_it_matters: Inspection setup and acceptance method depend on the GD&T symbol type.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat these as runout controls to datum A.

clarifications.question: Confirm whether circled dimensions 1.73 and 6.48 above the lower side view define an OD form-control zone start and length/span, or are special/significant dimensions with another convention.
clarifications.why_it_matters: This affects the controlled axial zone of the Ø9.12 datum OD and in-process inspection plan.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat 1.73 as the start coordinate and 6.48 as the length/span of the OD form-controlled zone.

clarifications.question: Confirm which internal features are supplied net-to-print by cold forming versus which require secondary machining or sizing.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The current plan assumes F005-F014 are primarily cold-formed, with optional light cleanup of the right cavity only. If the supplier leaves machining stock on internal features, additional lathe or special-tool operations are needed.
clarifications.suggested_default: Treat all complex internal seat/lip features as cold-formed near-net per drawing title, with only burr removal and optional right-cavity cleanup in-house.

clarifications.question: Provide cold-heading/cold-forming process data: wire diameter, slug length, number of forming stations/blows, and finish-machining allowance on OD/end faces.
clarifications.why_it_matters: These values are needed to finalize stock dimensions and complete forming/turning formula inputs without estimates.
clarifications.suggested_default: Use a near-net cold-formed blank based on the finished envelope Ø9.12 × 9.65 mm and 2.3 g mass until supplier data is available.

clarifications.question: Confirm leakage test pressure, medium, dwell time, flow direction, and fixture sealing surfaces for the 10 SCCM max requirement.
clarifications.why_it_matters: The functional test cannot be fully specified or quoted without the test conditions and fixture definition.
clarifications.suggested_default: Plan a dedicated axial flow leak-test fixture and use the drawing acceptance criterion of 10 SCCM max.

assumptions.text: The title phrase 'COLD FORMED' is treated as a manufacturing requirement, not merely a description of a previous prototype process.
C10C is treated as a low-carbon/mild cold-heading steel with easy machinability in the annealed/cold-formed condition.

No heat treatment, coating, grinding, or honing is required because the feature graph states heat treatment none, surface finish is not specified, and tolerances are achievable by cold forming plus careful CNC lathe/inspection.

Complex internal features F005-F014 are primarily created by the cold-forming/cold-extrusion die; secondary in-house machining is limited to datum OD/end faces, external edge details, deburr/cleaning, and optional right cavity cleanup.
Setup times are left as 0.0 placeholders because setup/cycle-time estimation is deferred to the post-processor; no manual time estimate has been calculated here.

analysis_trace.summary: Interpreted the feature graph as a very small axisymmetric C10C cold-formed leakdown plunger, Ø9.12 × 9.65 mm, with datum-A OD, datum C/B end faces, and a coaxial stepped internal check-valve/seat system. Critical items are OD ±0.025, runout controls to A, significant Ø6.88, no raised metal at Detail-B, and 10 SCCM max leakage.
issues: Internal bore depths and some GD&T symbol interpretations remain ambiguous.
Thin wall near Ø7.18 cavity creates clamping distortion risk.

analysis_trace.summary: Retrieved route sequences for turning, hole_making, and cold_heading. Turning applies to datum OD/end faces and coaxial cleanup; hole_making informs bore/deburr sequencing; cold_heading applies because the drawing title explicitly says cold formed and the part is small, axisymmetric, and C10C.
issues: Cold-heading volume guidance normally favors higher quantities, but the drawing title makes forming the governing process.
No heat-treatment route used because heat treatment is none.

analysis_trace.summary: Classified as a hybrid cylindrical part: cold-formed/cold-headed near-net blank plus secondary turning, inspection, and testing. Base geometry is cylindrical/axisymmetric.
issues: The closest stock enum for a cold-formed blank is 'forging'; notes clarify it is cold-headed/cold-extruded, not hot forged.

analysis_trace.summary: Searched routing corrections for hybrid cylindrical mild-steel part with external cylinder, internal bores, counterbores, tapered/check-valve seat, cold-formed features, Ø9.12 envelope, 9.65 length, and quantity 1000. No organization-specific corrections were returned.

Selected outsourced near-net cold-formed/cold-headed C10C blank because it is explicitly specified by the drawing title and best matches the small formed hollow geometry. Finished envelope values are used as bounding dimensions pending supplier slug/wire data.
issues: Exact wire diameter, slug length, die allowances, and number of blows require clarification.

analysis_trace.summary: Built the timeline as cold forming first, then in-house CNC lathe finish of datum faces/OD/edges, then manual deburr and clean, final inspection, and leakage test. No milling, heat treatment, grinding, coating, or saw operation is included.
issues: Right-cavity cleanup is conditional because the cold-formed cavity depth and finish state are not fully defined.

analysis_trace.summary: Decomposed into 6 setups and 19 sub-operations. Each sub-operation targets existing feature IDs only and includes geometry-based formula inputs from the feature graph where available.
issues: Several hole_depth_mm values are null because the feature graph does not contain resolved depths.

analysis_trace.summary: Verified coverage of all feature IDs F001-F016, logical stock-state progression, use of valid machine_family values, use of valid operation_type values, and sequencing rules: form before finish machining, datum/OD before flip inspection, deburr/clean before inspection and leakage test.
issues: Final production release still needs supplier cold-forming details and leak-test parameters.
